normalization.luma: legal code interval maps linearly to [0,1]
normalization.chroma: legal code interval maps linearly to centered [-0.5,0.5]

psnr.mse: unweighted arithmetic mean over the declared valid aperture
psnr.zero_mse: value is null and exact_match is true

ssim.kernel_construction: sample exp(-x^2/(2*sigma^2)) at integer offsets -5...5 and normalize
ssim.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of the SSIM map

ms_ssim.downsample: normalized 2x2 box followed by factor-two decimation
ms_ssim.odd_extent: reflect-101 pad the high edge to an even extent
ms_ssim.negative_component_policy: clamp scale means to [0,1] before exponentiation
ms_ssim.scale_combination: contrast-structure means at scales 1 through 4 and the complete SSIM mean at scale 5

artifact_metrics.edge_crossing: first 50-percent crossing along the declared normal, linear subpixel interpolation
artifact_metrics.ringing: maximum exterior overshoot and undershoot normalized by reference step amplitude
artifact_metrics.thin_line: integrated support contrast ratio and exterior absolute side-lobe energy normalized by reference contrast
artifact_metrics.chroma_displacement: absolute distance from each centered chroma zero crossing to the luma 0.5 crossing
artifact_metrics.alias: orthonormal two-dimensional DFT energy in a serialized Boolean forbidden mask divided by total energy

independent_oracle.implementation: direct two-dimensional convolution independent of production metric helpers

bootstrap.per_asset_aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of row deltas
bootstrap.aggregate: unweighted arithmetic mean across source assets
